items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: And it's unbelievable to me that I can say I once played for Bessie Smith.

ctx.x: You were talking about Bessie Smith.

So he asked me if I want to go play with her. And God knows, I didn't know where she was singing, I didn't know where I was playing... I took a few drinks; it was awful. Anyhow, I went with her to Binghamton, New York, at a theatre. I remember we stayed in a little house... Johnson City and Binghamton were together.
